info.title: My Activity Stats API
info.description: Canonical cross-backend HTTP contract. Existing URLs are preserved. GET endpoints also support HEAD (same status and headers, no body). Unsupported methods return 405 with Allow; unknown API URLs return 404 JSON. Every API response includes X-Request-Id. Object schemas with additionalProperties remain intentionally partial until domain DTO coverage is extended.

500.description: Synchronization failed; preserves the synchronization result payload.
